description: This source file contains Java test class 'ModuleConfigDTDTest_V1_7' which performs unit testing on the OpenMRS module configuration XML using JUnit 5. It tests the validity of generated XML configurations against a DTD schema, focusing on different versions and completion of Servlet configuration tags.

classes.name: ModuleConfigDTDTest_V1_7
classes.description: Test class for validating XML configuration files for OpenMRS modules against a DTD, focusing on version 1.7 and 2.0, particularly testing the servlet initialization parameters within XML configs.

methods.name: configXmlServletWithInitParams
methods.description: Parameterized test to generate a config XML with specified servlet init params and validate it against the DTD schema.

methods.name: configXmlServletMissingInitParamsIsValid
methods.description: Parameterized test to generate a config XML with servlet element missing init params and validate its correctness.

methods.name: getCompatibleVersions
methods.description: Provides stream of version arguments ('1.7', '2.0') for the parameterized tests.
